message: Last week, we had a little blackout while the kids were playing their favorite video game. As the room plunged into darkness, I quickly grabbed our flashlights and power banks, turning what could have been a grumpy moment into a fun family adventure. We ended up telling stories by flashlight, and even the kids forgot about their screens! It reminded me how a little preparedness can turn unexpected situations into memories. Have you ever turned a blackout into a family fun night?
